diagram_sources.caption: Program coordination, software authority, banking authority, delegated operations, and settlement responsibility remain distinct.
diagram_sources.title: Program Participants and Responsibility Model

diagram_sources.caption: Collective modernization shares software and standards, not production tenancy, institutional data, or authority.
diagram_sources.title: Independent Bank Deployments Under One Program

diagram_sources.caption: A common Settlement Institution may support multiple banks while each bank retains its own direct account, credentials, authority, and reconciliation.
diagram_sources.title: Direct Settlement Relationships

diagram_sources.caption: The operating model connects a banking request to a governed outcome without displacing the bank or Settlement Institution.
diagram_sources.title: Banking Operating Model

diagram_sources.caption: A Funding Event records recognized financial value; it does not create that value.
diagram_sources.title: Funding Event

diagram_sources.caption: Treasury distinguishes operational state while underlying funds remain in the bank's regulated relationships.
diagram_sources.title: Treasury

diagram_sources.caption: The canonical grammar moves from recognition to governed execution and resolution.

diagram_sources.caption: The deposit belongs to the bank-customer relationship; Treasury records only the approved operational recognition.
diagram_sources.title: Deposit Flow

diagram_sources.caption: Payroll remains a bank-governed service from employer authority through employee outcomes.
diagram_sources.title: Payroll Flow

diagram_sources.caption: Merchant activity is governed through the bank's Facility and direct settlement arrangements.
diagram_sources.title: Merchant Flow

diagram_sources.caption: Government disbursement remains subject to agency authority, bank governance, beneficiary conditions, and reconciliation.
diagram_sources.title: Government Disbursement Flow

diagram_sources.caption: The Commercial Waterfall is an accountability sequence separate from customer-fund custody and regulated settlement.
diagram_sources.title: Commercial Waterfall

diagram_sources.caption: Maintained software and delegated operations extend a bank-controlled deployment and direct settlement relationship.
diagram_sources.title: Deployment Architecture

diagram_sources.caption: The familiar remittance reference carries an instruction while the institution retains responsibility until release.
diagram_sources.title: Familiar Remittance Pattern

diagram_sources.caption: Different participants experience one banking activity governed by one institution.
diagram_sources.title: Operating Perspectives

diagram_sources.caption: Supporting funds, authority, purpose, readiness, instruction, and settlement remain distinct.
diagram_sources.title: Source-to-Settlement Operating Flow

diagram_sources.caption: The end-to-end grammar coordinates an authorized outcome while funds remain within the regulated banking relationship.
diagram_sources.title: End-to-End Banking Activity

diagram_sources.caption: New services vary purpose, participants, policies, conditions, and experience without rebuilding the operating foundation.
diagram_sources.title: One Ceremony, Many Banking Services

diagram_sources.caption: Transaction Gravity develops through recurring institutional usefulness, not volume alone.
diagram_sources.title: Transaction Gravity

diagram_sources.caption: Participating banks modernize collectively while competing and operating independently.
